summary: Completed backend testing of CryptoPanic News API endpoints. All 20 tests passed. The CryptoPanic integration is fully functional with the corrected base URL (https://cryptopanic.com/api/developer/v2).

minor.issue: Route conflict - news.py and cryptopanic.py both define /api/news/sentiment/{symbol}. The news.py route (AI sentiment) takes precedence. CryptoPanic's analyze_sentiment_for_coin() is not directly accessible via API.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ CryptoPanic service correctly uses the developer/v2 API endpoint
✓ Rate limiting implemented with 1 second minimum between requests
✓ Caching implemented with 5-minute TTL to reduce API calls
✓ Free tier limitations handled gracefully (empty url, source, votes, currencies)
✓ All filter types (trending, hot, bullish, bearish, important) working correctly
✓ Multi-coin news endpoint properly validates max 10 symbols
✓ Symbol case normalization working (lowercase converted to uppercase)
Note: /api/news/sentiment/{symbol} is handled by AI sentiment service (news.py), not CryptoPanic service
seed_data_creation: None - tests use live CryptoPanic API
context_for_next_testing_agent: CryptoPanic News API is fully functional. Free tier API returns limited fields (no URL, source details, votes, currencies). The /api/news/sentiment/{symbol} endpoint uses AI sentiment analysis from news.py, not the CryptoPanic service's analyze_sentiment_for_coin() method.

GET /api/news/trending.response: Returns trending news with filter='trending', news array, count

tests: All filter types (hot, rising, bullish, bearish, important) work

GET /api/news/sentiment/{symbol}.note: Handled by AI sentiment service (news.py), returns sentiment, confidence, ai_analysis, news_count, analyzed_at, recent_headlines

GET /api/news/market-overview.response: Returns market_sentiment_score (72.7), market_sentiment_label (bullish), trending/bullish/bearish/important counts, top_currencies, headlines

tests: Multi-coin news returns grouped by symbol

api_response_notes.free_tier_limitations: CryptoPanic free tier returns limited fields - no URL, source details, votes, or currencies in response
